implementation.argument_surface: three ordinary stack arguments are read (entry ESP+0x4, +0x8, +0xc) plus the ECX receiver, and a fourth slot at entry ESP+0x10 is popped without ever being read. observed_original_abi.receiver_note: the receiver is forwarded to 0x01021260 and 0x0105a050 and is never dereferenced in this body, which is exactly the machine-derived record's own abstention reason ecx_read_without_deref

The listing only ever writes AL (MOV AL,0x1 at 0x0105aa47), so the effective machine return is 8 bits wide and the declared int is the width the return claim is made at, not a claim about the upper three bytes.

mechanics.receiver_use: copied to ESI at 0x0105a895, forwarded to 0x01021260 at 0x0105a897 and to 0x0105a050 at 0x0105a8af, and never dereferenced
mechanics.first_argument_use: its word at displacement 0x124 is read three times (0x0105a8bc, 0x0105a8d7, 0x0105aa0e); a null value takes an early exit, and a non-null value is the receiver of 0x006e87e0 and 0x00cb5bb0
mechanics.forwarding: the second and third arguments are pushed unchanged as the second and third arguments of 0x0105a050, together with the first argument and an immediate 0
primary_control_flow: 0x0105a897: 0x01021260(receiver) runs first, before anything is read
0x0105a8af: 0x0105a050(receiver, arg1, arg2, arg3, 0) gates everything; a false result returns 1 immediately
0x0105a8bc: a null word at displacement 0x124 of the first argument returns 1
0x0105a8ca: a null result from the first 0x006e87e0 query returns 1; the query is then repeated and the result kept as the subject
0x0105a8eb: the subject's indirect word at displacement 0xc is asked about the key 0xce9f6639; a non-null answer goes to 0x01058680 and ends the dispatch
0x0105a90d: the same word asked about 0x3ed590d; the answer's word at displacement 0x88 must be 0, 1 or 2, and the call then goes to 0x010534c0 with the answer offset by 0x7c
0x0105a946: three alternative lookups (0x00ae6760, 0x00b67720, 0x00b67740) each paired with its own handler (0x01053320, 0x01053240, 0x010533d0); the first that produces something ends the dispatch

0x0105a99a: the last resort builds a three-word local, stores the produced object in its third word (displacement 0x8 of the block), constructs it with 0x00421c80 and 0x0067dcc0, calls the built object's indirect word at displacement 0x14 with the local and the tag immediate, and destroys the local with 0x00421cf0
0x0105a9cc: if 0x01030e40 produces nothing, 0x00bd8460 is tried and the same block is built with the other tag immediate; if that produces nothing either the block is skipped
0x0105aa0e: the word at displacement 0x124 of the first argument is released through 0x00cb5bb0
0x0105aa1d: the boolean carried in BL gates one last notification: 0x00a206f0, an optional indirect word at displacement 0x20 on the result, and 0x00435ed0 with the immediate 0x75c412dd
mechanics.carried_boolean: BL is set by exactly one of 0x01058680, 0x010534c0, 0x01053320, 0x01053240 or 0x010533d0, is preserved across the whole dispatch in EBX, and is popped at 0x0105aa1f. It gates the final notification and is never returned.

mechanics.pointee_access: the three-word local is constructed, written through, and destroyed inside the body; the first argument and the subject are only read

frame_derivation.method: ESP was walked by hand from the entry through every call, push and pop in the live listing. Entry ESP is E; SUB ESP,0x40 with PUSH EBP and PUSH ESI leaves E-0x48, and the epilogue (POP ESI, POP EBP, ADD ESP,0x40, RET 0x10) only balances from E-0x48, so E-0x48 is the restored frame and any other ESP value on a straight-line run is a caller-popped or callee-popped excursion.
frame_derivation.argument_slots: the three MOVs at 0x0105a89c, 0x0105a8a0 and 0x0105a8a4 read ESP+0x54, +0x50 and +0x4c at ESP=E-0x48, which are E+0xc, E+0x8 and E+0x4: the third, second and first stack arguments. Nothing reads E+0x10, yet RET 0x10 pops it.
frame_derivation.block_base: the three-word block is at E-0x10. 0x0105a9ac computes LEA ECX,[ESP+0x14] with ESP=E-0x50, giving E-0x3c, and 0x00421c80 callee-pops its one argument, so the store at 0x0105a9b5 writes E-0x34, which is displacement 0x8 of E-0x3c. Both arms of the block use the same three addresses: 0x0105a9c0 recomputes E-0x3c for the indirect call's second argument, and 0x0105aa04 recomputes E-0x3c for 0x00421cf0 after the indirect callee has popped its three arguments.
frame_derivation.indirect_call_width: the three pushes at 0x0105a9be, 0x0105a9c4 and 0x0105a9c5 are 12 bytes and there is no ADD ESP after 0x0105aa02, so that indirect callee pops all three; only under that reading does 0x0105aa04 land back on E-0x3c.
frame_derivation.callee_pop_versus_caller_pop: 0x01030e40 is called after PUSH EDI / PUSH ESI and followed by ADD ESP,0x4. Two words are pushed and only one is dropped, so the other belongs to the PUSH EDI / POP EDI register frame at 0x0105aa0d and the callee takes one caller-cleaned argument. The earlier candidate declared it callee-popping, which the ADD ESP,0x4 refutes; it is declared __cdecl here.
frame_derivation.why_this_matters: these four readings are what fix the local's store offset, the block base handed to two different callees, the argument width of the indirect call, and the calling convention of 0x01030e40. Each was re-derived from the live listing in this pass and each changed the candidate.

unresolved_questions: The committed pack's disassembly category is a truncated envelope, so every listing-dependent validation check reads NOT_AVAILABLE for this target. The listing used here came from the live bridge; a reader must not mistake it for the pack's own.

The receiver is forwarded and never dereferenced, so the machine-derived ABI record cannot name a receiver register and this reconstruction cannot say what the receiver is. Whether __stdcall with a register convention is excluded is not settled by this body alone.
The identity of 0x0105a050, the gate every path runs through, is not established; nothing in this body says what the three forwarded arguments mean.
What the word at displacement 0x124 of the first argument is, and whether 0x006e87e0 and 0x00cb5bb0 form an acquire/release pair on it, is not established.
The three keys 0xce9f6639, 0x3ed590d and 0x75c412dd, and the two tags 0xf46092d3 and 0xf46093da, are immediates with no recoverable meaning in this body.
The enumeration compared against the word at displacement 0x88 accepts 0, 1 and 2 but nothing here says what those three states are.

Whether the three-word local is a command, an event or a scoped context, and what the word at displacement 0x8 of it means, is not established; only the tag immediates distinguish the two construction paths.
ECX is not established at the 0x00a206f0 call site, so that callee's receiver is unknown; the reconstruction declares it argumentless and says so.
